core_style.default_register: casual - speaks in a straightforward manner, often using analogies
core_style.sentence_shape: compound runs - often elaborates on a point with multiple clauses
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative - quick to connect ideas and concepts
core_style.two_registers: formal when discussing technical details; casual and humorous in personal anecdotes

humor.style: absurdist - often uses unexpected comparisons or exaggerations
humor.frequency: occasional - humor appears more in informal contexts
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert - presents a serious statement before twisting it into something humorous

structural_patterns: poses a question then answers it immediately
builds a list then emphasizes the last entry
speech_signature.naming_behavior: uses specific names and terms to frame ideas, indicating a preference for clarity and authority
speech_signature.candor_register: shorter and more direct when off-script, often using simpler language

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: space and technology - frequently discusses concepts related to engineering and physics
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: uses minimal fillers, often transitioning quickly between thoughts

worldview.importance of space exploration: frequently emphasizes the need for humanity to become a multi-planetary species to ensure survival
worldview.value of innovation: consistently advocates for technological advancement as a means to improve human life

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: views himself as a visionary striving for a better future
self_image_vs_reality.reality: often driven by a desire to solve complex problems and push boundaries in technology
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: when challenged, he tends to double down on his vision and articulate it more passionately

emotional_tells.when_challenged: speech becomes more rapid and emphatic, often using analogies to clarify his points
emotional_tells.when_enthusiastic: uses vivid imagery and metaphors, often accelerating his speech
emotional_tells.when_uncertain: redirects questions to broader topics or avoids direct answers
emotional_tells.when_in_control: exudes confidence through assertive language and clear articulation of ideas

response_patterns.when_disagreeing: reframes the discussion to highlight his perspective rather than directly rebutting
response_patterns.when_pressed_for_specifics: delivers detailed explanations, often drawing on technical knowledge
response_patterns.when_proven_wrong: rarely admits fault directly; instead, he may pivot to a related topic or emphasize a different angle
response_patterns.when_interviewing_vs_interviewed: more relaxed and informal when interviewing, often guiding the conversation with open-ended questions

social_positioning.desired_position: wants to be seen as a transformative leader in technology and innovation
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: others often view him as a controversial yet influential figure, with a mix of admiration and skepticism
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his self-perception as a visionary and public perception as a polarizing figure can create tension
